title: 第23章 不能用灵修玩了第24章 成为大队长
content_zh:
“开始吧，点到为止，不要伤到对方。”孟阔下令。
这场比试输赢无所谓，大不了让江平安当中队长。
战斗一开始，杨虎拎着九环大刀冲了过去。
有点经验的武者就知道，想要打败灵修，就与其近战。
灵修在同境界的力量不足，而且近战还容易被打断施法。
总结起来就一句话，灵修的弱点，就是近战能力不足的。
很多灵修都会修炼剑术、刀术之类的弥补这个缺陷。
江平安迅速掐诀释法，施展《土墙术》。
杨虎脚下的土壤突然抬高一截，这要是不注意，或许会摔个跟头。
别看杨虎长得粗犷，心却很细，双腿用力，高高跃起，躲过脚下的土墙，向着江平安劈去。
江平安快速释放火球术，一个人头大小的火球，释放着恐怖的火焰砸向空中的杨虎。
在空中非常不容易躲开攻击。
这就是他的目的。
杨虎大喝一声，猛地挥动手里的刀。
猛烈的刀锋直接将火球劈开。
看着对方冲来，江平安身体高高跃起，跳到房顶，继续施展火球术进攻。
杨虎迅落在地上，双腿用力，身体弹射出去，冲向江平安。
江平安施展疾风步，在房顶快速移动起来。
这次使用的是《疾风步》，体内能量在腿上运转，加快移动速度，达到此身法的最高境界可踏草而行。
他从山羊胡修士那里得到四部术法，现在都在学习。

杨虎挥着刀追击，江平安也不正面攻击，就在房顶上跳来跳去，不时释放火球术，仿佛放风筝一样。
“小子！你跑什么啊，是不是爷们啊！”
杨虎并不算灵活，只能借助力量跳跃，在房顶上跑动，一个不小心脚就会陷下去，很难追上对方。
“我不是爷们，我还是孩子。”
江平安面对挑衅完全不上当，继续跳下来跳，不与对方近战，不时释放两个火球术攻击。
“将军！这小子耍无赖！”杨虎对着孟阔告状，这个样子他根本打不到对方。
孟阔淡淡道：“世上从来就没有公平的战斗。”
杨虎见将军没有打算制止的样子，只能咬牙继续追击。
两人就这么在房顶上追跑了一盏茶的功夫，
杨虎崩溃了，不论他怎么追都追不上江平安，火球不时在身上滑过，胡子都快烧没了。
“啊~”
杨虎爆吼一声，声音穿云，身子从房顶重重落了下去。
“不打了！没意思！大队长这个职位我不要了还不行么！”
他这个暴脾气根本受不了这个罪，一直挨打，可自己却连对方的衣服角都碰不到。
“你脾气太暴躁，这心智当不了大队长。”
江平安站在房顶上，淡淡说道。
众人：“……”
如果是别人说这话，会认为对方说得很对。
content_en:
"Let's start, just stop there and don't hurt the other party." Meng Kuo ordered.
It doesn't matter whether he wins or loses in this competition. The worst thing he can do is let Jiang Ping'an become the captain.
As soon as the battle started, Yang Hu rushed over with a nine-ring sword.
A warrior with some experience will know that if you want to defeat Ling Xiu, you have to fight him in close combat.
Spiritual training is not powerful enough in the same realm, and it is easy to interrupt spellcasting in close combat.
To sum it up in one sentence, the weakness of spiritual practice is its lack of close combat ability.
Many spiritual practitioners will practice swordsmanship, knife skills, etc. to make up for this shortcoming.
Jiang Ping'an quickly explained the technique and performed the "Earth Wall Technique".
The soil under Yang Hu's feet suddenly rose. If he didn't pay attention, he might fall down.
Although Yang Hu looks rough, he has a delicate heart. With strong legs, he jumped high, dodged the earth wall under his feet, and slashed towards Jiang Ping'an.
Jiang Ping'an quickly released the fireball technique. A fireball the size of a human head released terrifying flames and hit Yang Hu in the air.
It's very difficult to dodge attacks in the air.
This is his purpose.
Yang Hu shouted loudly and swung the knife in his hand.
The fierce blade split the fireball directly.
Seeing the opponent rushing towards him, Jiang Ping'an jumped up high, jumped to the roof, and continued to use the fireball technique to attack.
Yang Huxun landed on the ground, pushed his legs hard, and ejected his body, rushing towards Jiang Ping'an.
Jiang Ping'an used Wind Step and moved quickly on the roof.
This time I used the "Wind Step". The energy in the body circulates on the legs, speeding up the movement. When the highest level of this movement is reached, one can walk on the grass.
He received four techniques from the Goatee Beard monk and is currently learning them.
Yang Hu pursued him with a knife, but Jiang Ping'an did not attack directly. He jumped up and down on the roof, releasing fireballs from time to time, as if flying a kite.
"Boy! Why are you running away? Are you a man?"
Yang Hu is not very flexible and can only use his strength to jump and run on the roof. If he is not careful, his foot will sink and it will be difficult to catch up with the opponent.
"I'm not a man, I'm still a child."
Jiang Ping'an didn't fall for the provocation at all, and continued to jump up and down without engaging in close combat with the opponent, releasing two fireball attacks from time to time.
"General! This kid is acting like a rogue!" Yang Hu complained to Meng Kuo. He couldn't hit him like this.
Meng Kuo said calmly: "There is never a fair fight in the world."
Seeing that the general had no intention of stopping him, Yang Hu could only grit his teeth and continue the pursuit.
The two of them chased each other on the roof for a cup of tea.
Yang Hu collapsed. No matter how hard he chased, he could not catch up with Jiang Ping'an. Fireballs slid over his body from time to time, and his beard was almost burned off.
"Ah~"
Yang Hu roared loudly, his voice piercing the clouds, and his body fell heavily from the roof.
"No fighting! It's boring! I don't want the position of captain, why not!"
He had a bad temper and couldn't bear this crime. He kept getting beaten, but he couldn't even touch the corner of the other person's clothes.
"You have a bad temper and don't have the brains to be a captain."
Jiang Ping'an stood on the roof and said calmly.
Everyone: "..."
If someone else said this, they would think they were right.
